subject: Marketing opt-in swap with monetary reciprocity — approval required
messages:
From: Claire Moreno <claire.moreno@vertexhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract details & a quick question on marketing opt-in

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team is excited about the potential performance gains and predictable latency Redwood promises. We have one internal ask from our CMO before we move to signature: Vertex is willing to be a reference and participate in a short case study + grant logo usage on your website if we can secure an additional 15% one-time credit to the committed spend (applied at close).

Rationale: marketing wants a small, co-branded asset and a joint webinar in Q1; given their budget cycles, the extra credit helps the deal land inside our Q4 commit. We’re not asking for exclusivity, just the ability to use the case study in Redwood-owned channels and a short quote from our VP Product.

Can you confirm if Redwood would consider a swap like that? If so, what approvals would you need and what guardrails do you require on usage/quote?

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Moreno
Head of Partnerships, Vertex Health
claire.moreno@vertexhealth.com
+1 415-555-0193

Attachment: Vertex_SOW_outline.pdf (attachment referenced)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: claire.moreno@vertexhealth.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract details & a quick question on marketing opt-in

Laura / Karthik — forwarding Claire’s ask. TL;DR: customer asks for 15% one-time credit in exchange for a case study + logo use + joint webinar. They explicitly said no exclusivity.

My initial read: we can probably trade marketing visibility for credits but 15% is above deal-desk thresholds for photos/marketing swaps. Proposed compromise: 12% one-time credit (applied as usage credit over first 90 days) + 6-month featured case study, plus one co-hosted webinar. Conditions we should insist on:
- Customer marketing must approve final case study language and quotes before publication.
- Logo usage limited to Redwood website / one-pager / webinar slides and must follow Vertex logo guide (they attached).
- No customer PII in the case study; redact any sample queries.
- MOU signed with explicit brand-usage clause and a 3-month embargo on publication after sign-off to give both comms teams time to coordinate.

Karthik — can you review the attached draft MOU and flag any legal blockers (indemnity, data claims, exclusivity, IP)? If we accept 12% we need exec signoff for anything above our 10% sales threshold. Laura — can you quantify where 12% lands on deal economics vs. 10%? Is 12% acceptable if we get a webinar and three-month social push?

I’ll pause on countering publicly until we have legal input.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_mou_draft.pdf, credit_schedule.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract details & a quick question on marketing opt-in

Vivek / Laura — I reviewed the draft MOU. High-level legal notes:
- Do not grant any exclusivity or evergreen publicity rights. MOU should be explicit that rights are non-exclusive and time-limited (6 months as Vivek suggested).
- Add a clear customer sign-off clause: Vertex marketing must sign off on final case study copy before any publication and Redwood must provide at least 5 business days for review.
- Remove any implicit indemnity for statements in the case study; we can include a mutual representations clause about accuracy of quotes.
- Add a clause preventing the use of Vertex-specific performance metrics unless Vertex independently verifies them (we can include anonymized examples).
- We should include an approval flow and a single point of contact on both sides for marketing sign-off to avoid delays.

If leadership approves a credit >10%, I recommend we tie the credit release schedule to completed marketing milestones (e.g., 50% credit at signature, remainder after case study live + webinar completed). That reduces risk of paying for promised but unexecuted PR.

I’ll redline the PDF and return by EOD Thursday.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Claire Moreno <claire.moreno@vertexhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract details & a quick question on marketing opt-in

Claire — appreciate the clarity and the attached logo guide. Quick note to make this move: Vertex is a strategic target for us and the webinar + case study have real GTM value.

Proposal from sales side: we can agree to a 10% one-time credit without exec escalation. If Redwood execs approve up to 12% (contingent on Karthik’s redlines) we’ll accept 12% provided the credit is structured as: 50% at signature, 50% after the case study publishes and the webinar runs. Also require marketing sign-off on all assets and a 6-month term for the case study visibility.

Claire — would Vertex agree to the milestone-based credit schedule and to provide a marketing POC for copy approvals? If yes, I can move this to legal + finance for final MOU/credit schedule.

Thanks — pinging Vivek for final on the discount % (anything above 10% needs exec OK per deal desk).

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: vertex_logo_guidelines.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Claire Moreno <claire.moreno@vertexhealth.com>, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Marketing opt-in swap — approval up to 12% conditional on MOU and comms sign-off

Team / Claire — after reviewing deal economics and Karthik’s redline plan, I will approve up to 12% one-time credit on DEAL-2026-0932 with the following conditions:

1) Credit schedule: 50% applied at signature; 50% released after public case study goes live AND the co-hosted webinar takes place (must be within 120 days of signature).
2) MOU must contain the non-exclusive, time-limited (6 months) brand usage clause, customer marketing sign-off flow, and the embargo window (3 business days for simultaneous internal coordination).
3) No customer performance metrics will be published without Vertex’s explicit written verification.
4) Marketing assets must be reviewed by Redwood Comms and Vertex Marketing; any third-party press outreach requires mutual approval.

Finance & CS: please coordinate to ensure the 50% credit posts as a usage credit (credit_schedule.csv attached) and restrict application to the agreed committed spend lines. Redact any PII in the case study materials per our data policy.

Claire — if Vertex agrees to the milestone schedule and the sign-off flow, we’ll get legal to publish the redlined MOU and send a DocuSign envelope. I’ve CC’d Mark (Finance) to expedite the credit booking.

Approved by: Vivek Kulkarni, Head of Sales (email approval sufficient).

Thanks all — let’s aim to have the legal MOU to Claire by EOD Friday.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_mou_draft.pdf (redlined pending), credit_schedule.csv, link to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-Vertex-CaseStudy
